prompt.adult: To whom did the angel bring the news of Jesus' birth out in the fields?
prompt.child: Angels shared good news with some people out in the fields the night Jesus was born. Who were they?
prompt.teen: On the night Jesus was born, angels gave good news to some people out in the fields. Who were they?
prompt.older: According to Luke 2:8, who were in the fields near Bethlehem when the angel brought the good news?

verses.text: Now there were in the same country shepherds living out in the fields, keeping watch over their flock by night.

explanation.adult: Luke 2:8 tells who was in the fields that night and what they were doing. Read the first line.
explanation.child: Read Luke 2:8. It tells who was out in the fields that night and what they were doing.
explanation.teen: Check Luke 2:8. It tells who was out in the fields that night and what they were up to.
explanation.older: Luke 2:8 describes the persons in the fields that night and their occupation.

teaching.extended_explanation: The first people to hear the news were not in a palace. The verse tells who they were, where they were, and what they were doing at night.
teaching.takeaway: Shepherds in the fields heard the angels' good news.

prompt.adult: Why did Joseph take Mary on a trip right before Jesus was born?
prompt.child: Before Jesus was born, Joseph took Mary on a trip. Why did they go?
prompt.teen: Before Jesus was born, Joseph and Mary made a trip. Why did they go?
prompt.older: According to Luke 2:3-5, for what purpose did Joseph travel with Mary before Jesus was born?

choices.text: To visit the king in his palace
To sell their animals at the market
To find a bigger house to live in

verses.text: So all went to be registered, everyone to his own city.
to be registered with Mary, his betrothed wife, who was with child.

explanation.adult: Luke 2:3 and 2:5 give the reason for the travel. Look for the repeated phrase in both verses.
explanation.child: Read Luke 2:3 and 2:5. Both verses tell why everyone was traveling to their own cities.
explanation.teen: Check Luke 2:3 and 2:5. Both verses give the reason everyone was heading to their own cities.
explanation.older: Luke 2:3 and 2:5 give the reason for the journey, expressed in a phrase that appears in both verses.

teaching.extended_explanation: A ruler had made a rule for everyone. These two verses show what everyone did because of it and how Joseph and Mary were part of it.
teaching.takeaway: Joseph and Mary went to be counted (registered).
